in_marathi.name: Deeptiman
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deeptiman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit 'Deep' meaning 'deep' and 'Timan' meaning 'mind'. It is a name given to a child who is believed to have a profound mind or deep understanding.
